messages:
jen (Recruiter): FYI — offer packet ready for Maya K. Role IC3, currently UK remote. Proposal: base $165,000 + $10,000 sign-on + standard equity. We think this is above L3-US band top. Need people-ops + finance sign-off. Candidate has counteroffer deadline 2026-05-20. Can we fast-track? :eyes:

liam (People Ops): Quick Q — is the hire expected to be UA/US-headquartered? If they stay in UK remote, comp parity rules apply and pay should be localized. Cross-border exception required for above-band if we want US band. Routing to comp committee likely. cc @drew (Finance)

anika (Hiring Manager): Role is customer-facing in EST hours. Candidate is open to relocating but needs visa support; earliest realistic relocation is late Q3. Preference is June 1 start if paperwork allows. We proposed $165k to be competitive — that's ~10% above band top ($150k). Can we approve the delta as a recruiting exception?

drew (Finance): We can consider an exception but need budget sign-off. Also note payroll implications: if they start remote in UK, payroll/tax differs and we may need to pay localized salary until relocation. Sign-on payment rules may require proration based on payroll cutoffs. :money_with_wings:

liam (People Ops): Plan: I'll open a formal comp-exception routing and notify comp chair (olivia). Need manager justification + recruiter packet. Please use this template in the ticket:

```
Candidate: Maya K
Role: Senior SWE (IC3)
Proposed comp: Base $165000, Sign-on $10000, Equity 0.10% (vesting per standard)
Current band: L3-US (band top $150000)
Start options: 2026-06-01 (preferred), 2026-05-12
Constraints: candidate counteroffer deadline 2026-05-20; relocation/visa timeline TBD
Hiring manager justification: market scarcity + customer-facing overlap with EST
```

anika (Hiring Manager): Can we expedite? candidate's counteroffer deadline is 2026-05-20 — board/comp chair review within 48 hours would be ideal. :alarm_clock:

hr-bot: Automated: Comp exception ticket created CE-2026-078. Please attach the completed offer doc, manager justification, and recruiter notes. Expected review SLA: 48 business hours. Reminder: cross-border hires require immigration checklist.

jen (Recruiter): Attached offer PDF (link: drive.redwood/incoming/maya_k_offer.pdf). Also note candidate prefers June 1 but can be flexible to 5/12 if visa allows. Need legal on visa feasibility before commitment.

nora (Legal): For relocation to US, visa pathways (H-1 transfer or new H-1) will likely take months; immediate US start by June 1 is unlikely. Recommendation: extend a remote-UK initial hire with relocation support later; any above-band approval should be contingent on payroll transfer and immigration steps.

drew (Finance): Given legal note, recommend paying UK-localized salary until relocation. Approve sign-on as retention payment contingent on relocation completion and payroll move. Finance will confirm proration and timing after comp committee note. :white_check_mark:

liam (People Ops): Summary/ask: routing to comp chair (olivia) now. Suggested decision options: 1) Approve above-band (US pay) contingent on relocation and payroll move; 2) Approve sign-on only now and hire on UK-localized band; 3) Decline above-band. Please respond in-thread with :thumbsup: to agree with option 1, :thumbsdown: to decline, or message alternatives.

olivia (Comp Chair): Will review CE-2026-078 today. Given candidate deadline, leaning to option 2 (sign-on + UK band now) unless relocation timeline accelerates. Will post final by EOD.

anika (Hiring Manager): :thumbsup: to option 2 for now — keeps candidate engaged and aligns with legal. Please expedite.

jen (Recruiter): Thanks — I'll communicate tentative offer with sign-on contingent and note potential relocation bump. Will update CE ticket with payroll location once we have confirmation.
